about_the_game:
Long ago the last desperate remainder of humanity stood against the vicious ogre hordes. Against all odds, the humans fought back the ruthless attackers who had savaged their homelands and eradicated the ogre forces for all who followed. Or so they believed. Generations later, the stories have kept the fear of ogres alive in the human populace, though the ogres themselves are thought of nearly as myth.

Now the ogres have returned and you must take up the legendary mantle of The Ogrewatch to guard your village against them. Take your place in the ancient tower and hold your position as the ogre hordes march toward you. Kill them all or watch your people fall to ruin.

Upgrade your weapon

As you kill ogres you'll be able to select from various upgrades to improve your crossbow. Choose wisely to keep up with the ever-massing waves of attackers.

Awaken ancient power

Uncover the tower's secrets to unlock its hidden power and keep the ogres at bay.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700HQ
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: You stand as the last line of defense against the oncoming ogre horde that threatens to destroy your village. Armed with a crossbow, you must hold the ancient Ogrewatch Tower as waves of Ogres march against you in this first-person tower defense game.
